messages:
Priya: Sketch attached — proposal to surface a compact invoice row for org-level view. Idea: single-line summary, tiny sparkline, token total and a chevron to expand details. Link: https://img.redwood/mock/compact-invoice.png Jon: I like the single-line density. Two quick asks: 1) make the sparkline tappable to open line-item modal, 2) keep download invoice CTA visible without expand (export is common). Elliot: Technical: if download remains visible, we'll need an API change to embed breakdowns server-side when requested. Current endpoint is /invoices/:id?format=csv only returns totals. Can add `expand_breakdowns=true`. Zoe: From finance feedback: label consistency matters. If we show "tokens" in project-level and "compute units" in org-level that confuses auditors. Suggest primary label be "tokens" everywhere, with a small secondary label: "(aka compute units)" in settings or tooltip. Priya: Good call. What about a user-controlled toggle in billing settings: "Display billing in compute units" so teams can opt-in? Jon: That would work. For the compact row, recommend we show an affordance: "2,450 tokens ▾" where ▾ is keyboard-focusable. Hover reveals tooltip: "See detailed token distribution" Elliot: Accessibility: the chevron should be a real
...line items...
``` Priya: UX question: should we auto-expand single-project invoices? I'd prefer auto-expand for single-project since users come expecting detail. For org list keep compact. Zoe: CSV export change: +1 to server-side param. Also add a column header for "project_id" when expand is true so downstream joins don't break. Jon: Visual nit: compact row needs >= 4.5:1 contrast for the tiny sparkline and chevron. Also ensure focus ring isn't cut off in narrow rows. infra-bot: Deploy note: new invoice export route requires db index on invoice_id + project_id for performance. Migration ticket: MIG-2025. Elliot: Dev estimate: frontend compact row + keyboard flows ~2 dev days, modal + aria live ~1 day, export API + migration ~2-3 days, QA + accessibility pass ~1 day. Priya: Acceptance criteria for PR: compact row appears on org view, sparkline is tappable, download CTA always present, `expand_breakdowns=true` server-side export, toggle for compute units in billing settings, aria attributes and aria-live implemented, tests for CSV headers. Jon: I'll update the visuals and add a low-fidelity prototype showing keyboard tab order. Zoe: We'll send the billing team a screenshot and ask about the compute-units toggle wording. Priya: Plan: ship as a minor release after the dashboard rollout. I'll file the export API ticket and tag @elliot. Elliot: On it. I'll link the migration PR when ready. Priya: Thanks team — posting updated mock and accessibility checklist once designs are in. :sparkles:
